{{recipe}}

'''Khoresht bamiye''' is a Persian lamb and okra stew. 

==Ingredients==
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], peeled and thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* [[Cookbook: Vegetable Oil|Cooking oil]]
* 500 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] stewing [[Cookbook:Lamb|lamb]] or [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]], cut into small pieces 
* 750 grams [[Cookbook:Okra|okra]], washed with stems trimmed 
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Black pepper]] 
* 3–4 spoons [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]] 
* 2–3 spoons fresh [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]] juice

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] the sliced onion in oil until slightly golden.
#Add the meat and fry with the onions until the color changes.
#Add 3 glasses of hot water and bring to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Turn heat down and let boil slowly for about 45 minutes, adding more hot water during cooking if needed.
#Add okra, salt, pepper, and tomato paste to the meat. Cook for another 10–15 minutes. Take care not to overcook the okras so that they do not become slippery.
#Add lime juice and adjust seasoning. Cook for another 3–4 minutes.
#Serve with white [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]].

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If desired, potatoes can also be added to khoresht bamieh. In that case, 500 grams of potatoes should be washed, peeled and cut into small pieces, and added in with 500 grams of okra (or slightly earlier; required cooking time depends somewhat on the size of the cut pieces).
